A few weeks after the beginning of the new academic year, your mentor asks to speak to you. Why do they want to speak to you? 
 
They might want to ask me something. 

On a scale of 1-5, how likely is this thought to pop into your mind?

buttons: 1::1 (Circled/Bolded);2::2;3::3: Might pop up in my mind;4::4;5::5: Definitely pops up in my mind;
